resources.string: 30 keeps the game at full speed (logic at 60) and draws every other frame: for weak phones, less heat and battery. 120 shows in-between pictures (needs a 120 Hz screen and uses more CPU and battery).
Applies at 60 and 120. If the phone cannot reach 60 frames a second the game would run in slow motion; automatic then draws every other frame (as at 30) only while needed. No effect at 30.
Lowers the internal resolution when the GPU cannot keep the chosen rate; the resolution above is the ceiling.
